<issue>
PNG image parsing fails with incorrect endianness

#### Description

When processing PNG images, the library fails to correctly parse image metadata like dimensions and DPI. The PNG chunk parser is using the wrong byte order when reading the image stream.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.image import Image

# Try to load a PNG image
with open('test_image.png', 'rb') as stream:
    image = Image.from_file(stream)
    print(f"Width: {image.px_width}")
    print(f"Height: {image.px_height}")
    print(f"DPI: {image.horz_dpi}")
```

The above code will fail to correctly read PNG image properties, returning incorrect values or raising errors when trying to parse the PNG chunks.
</issue>
